text:
alex: quick question — about to land a tiny terraform change that changes the configmap key ordering which will bump the checksum annotation. should trigger k8s rollout for model-serving. anyone see caveats before i apply? i can run a quick smoke test after apply.

riley: sounds OK but watch pods that mount the cm as env; they don't always restart on annotation change unless the deployment template changes.

morgan: do we have canonicalization for the map so reorderings don't cause unnecessary rollouts? if not, we should add it.

alex: i added a sort in my branch, but worried about older deployments that have the previous annotation format (different prefix).

infra-bot: terraform plan finished: kubernetes_deployment.redwood-models will change annotation "config-sha" from "sha256:abcd" to "sha256:ef01".

jamie: pinging @eng-runtime — any services reading the config-sha metric/label? could be noisy in dashboards.

sara: autoscaler reads a label on the deployment, not the annotation, so scaling should be unaffected.

riley: also check the secret-sync operator — it used to watch that annotation in an older version and re-annotate secrets, which triggered cert rotations.

alex: good catch. operator v2 ignores "config-sha" but some clusters still run v1. i'll rename the annotation to "cm-checksum-v2" so older operators don't react.

morgan: for smoke: after apply, curl a couple health endpoints and tail startup logs. also run `kubectl rollout status deployment/redwood-models --timeout=2m`.

alex: plan: 1) apply in staging 2) smoke test (health endpoints, logs, rollout status) 3) monitor metrics/alerts for 30m 4) apply to prod during maintenance window. i'll post results here.

jamie: code review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 — left a small comment about serde ordering in the helper util.

alex: addressed the comment and pushed. applying to staging in ~5m.

infra-bot: apply complete in staging at 1708954523 — deployment restarted 3/3 pods, rollout succeeded.

alex: staging smoke: health OK, no 500s in logs, autoscaler unaffected. saw one pod emit a transient kvcache load warning at startup; opened INF-2419 to track.

sara: nice. when you do prod, ping on-call and set maintenance message in status page.

alex: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
